_comment: Optional. Priority: clip_colors > camera_colors_always > time_colors > camera_colors. Colors are Resolve clip color names: Orange, Apricot, Yellow, Lime, Olive, Green, Teal, Navy, Blue, Purple, Violet, Pink, Tan, Beige, Brown, Chocolate. Times are local clock times of the shoot day. A window can be limited to certain cameras with "cameras": ["C"] (camera label = file name without the numbers).
_auto_day_parts: Instead of writing time_colors by hand, set "auto_day_parts": true to derive them from the recordings' names (vows, first look, ceremony, speeches, DJ ...).
